snippet.title: The Last Call: Teaser Game Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4222280/The_Last_Call/

The Last Call is an FMV + FPS action game. Mack is an ex-DEA agent armed with the memories of his murdered wife and an unstoppable rage. Mack will need to wage a one-man war SEARCHING drug safehouses and SHOOTING through cartel nightclubs to deliver his own brand of justice… no matter the cost. 

The Last Call Coming Soon.
